sentence: That is the same by-year pattern this site has already documented for [Breast Cancer Awareness Month](/breast-cancer-awareness-month/), though the two observances didn't get there the same way.

[No-Shave November](/no-shave-november/), which shares the same 30 days, has never had any federal recognition at all, at any level, a reminder that Lung Cancer Awareness Month's 2020 Senate resolution and 2022 presidential proclamation put it on firmer government footing than most of the observances crowding the same month, even without a standing statute behind it.
